decisions_for_user: F352-free: building a-task-nothing-will-move-holds-nobody answers it as a sixth option, (f) reachability - an assigned live task holds its agent only while its loop has not ended or a turn is running/queued for that agent on it. The operator set this direction in session 2026-09-14 23:30, so it does not stop the change (proposal.md 'OPERATOR QUESTION'). Noted for the record.

F128 widened by a-task-nothing-will-move-holds-nobody (R2, design D3): a plain (documentless) loop whose agent is mid-turn can now hand its next pending task to a sibling holding only bookmarks, where a bookmark used to shield it. F128's decision (loop-scoped free list, or stop presenting job.agent as who runs the loop) is still yours and still open; the change proceeds without taking it.

a-task-nothing-will-move-holds-nobody R3 (design D8): the busy guard now also refuses a firing when the loop holds no open task, in every project. A busy or held agent's empty loop no longer queues a briefing per tick (F372, measured: 3 firings, 3 entries, Run 200). Consequence: in multi-agent projects a never-filled loop's first briefing, a drained loop's emptiness stop, and a pending loop edit now wait for the agent's turn to end, as they already do in single-agent projects. Not a decision you need to take, but it is behaviour you will see.

F373 (B, filed R3, measured): Run on a loop whose work is in flight can answer with an earlier firing's stale 'loop queue is stalled' reason (jobs.py:1359 reads the newest skipped row without asking whether this press wrote it). Route-only repair sketched in the ledger. Not in tonight's ORDER, not built; the reachability change widens its reach.

F370 (B, filed R2): today's held-resume arm (c8e3bbd, scheduler.py:1506) re-briefs a held assignee every firing when input for an agent whose name sorts first also names its task. One-line repair once the reachability change's pair function exists; not in tonight's ORDER, so not built.

Design D2 of that change: a PAUSED loop's tasks still hold their agents (only an ended loop frees them). If the operator wants a pause to free agents, it is one clause (AIJob.enabled) and task 1.4's test flips.
